 SRA encourages seniors to seek assistance with Medicare enrollment 
 By Connor Barry 
 on 
 October 25, 2026 
 With the beginning of the Medicare Open Enrollment Period, the Senior Resource Alliance is encouraging Central Florida seniors to reach out and take advantage of the SHINE program. 
 The Serving Health Insurance Needs of Elders, or SHINE, program offers free and unbiased Medicare counseling services to seniors with questions about their coverage needs. 
 The Senior Resource Alliance offers a wide range of services and connects seniors with other resources. (INSTAGRAM.COM/SRA_FLORIDA) 
 “Our team is hearing from people who have questions about their Medicare coverage and the changes they may see in 2027,” Karla Radka, SRA president and CEO, said in a press release. “Our trained SHINE counselors are available to help Central Florida’s Medicare beneficiaries better understand their choices and select the coverage that best meets their individual circumstances.” 
 Medicare open enrollment runs from Oct. 15 through Dec. 7. To schedule a session with SHINE, call 1-800-96-ELDER or visit SeniorResourceAlliance.org/medicare-counseling .  
 SHINE also offers free counseling year-round to assist with things like understanding your coverage; comparing health and drug plans; learning about costs; identifying beneficial programs; and detecting or reporting Medicare fraud, errors or abuse.
